detailed_description: Text Shadow Generator is a visual CSS tool that helps you create beautiful text shadow effects for your web projects. Adjust horizontal and vertical offsets, blur radius, spread, and color to achieve the perfect shadow effect. The live preview shows your changes in real-time, and you can add multiple shadow layers for complex effects. Whether you're creating subtle depth, glowing text, or dramatic 3D effects, this tool generates clean CSS code you can copy directly into your stylesheets.
